moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ui-cursorarc, written here): Targets 52x28 r8. Recipe: each move 900 ms power2.inOut along a slight arc (perpendicular offset = sin(π q) × 0.06 × segment length), pause 100 ms, click. Demo: 1 s cycles visiting (60,60) → (250,80) → (120,150): move over 0.7 s with smoothstep, arc 0.12 × length, pause 50 ms, press 100 ms (cursor scale 0.85, the target fills accent). Params: keys [[giây, x, y, bấm]] · move (0.9 s, power2.inOut) · arc (0.06 × quãng) · pause (0.1 s) · press (0.1 s). The recipe: 0.9 s moves (power2.inOut) on an arc of 0.06 × the distance, a 0.1 s pause, then the click.
